intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create this arm's independently chosen complex photorealistic test scene in the flooded baroque library manuscript rescue lane, using the attached image only to inform the unmistakably adult woman's appearance and keeping her unobscured face and entire hair arrangement readable for later semantic-render evaluation.

Create a photorealistic narrative image of a flooded baroque library manuscript rescue centered on one unmistakably adult woman visually informed by the supplied appearance reference: an oval face, softly arched brows, almond-shaped dark eyes, a delicate straight nose, and naturally full lips. She braces against a marble reading table and pulls an illuminated manuscript from a collapsing carved shelf into a raised archival cradle while ankle-deep water carries loose gilded folios between toppled globes and ladders. Preserve clear rescue causality between the shelf giving way, her hands securing the volume, and the manuscript reaching safety. Give equal visual priority to her unobscured, recognizable face and the complete readable arrangement of her hair from crown to ends, alongside convincingly photorealistic architectural damage, reflected floodwater, and fragile paper textures.

render_gates.description: The image visibly commits to one identifiable source medium or protocol rather than an unspecified digital mood.
Artifacts share one technically coherent failure family native to the selected medium or protocol.
A deliberate bounded rupture is compositionally legible instead of uniform decorative noise across the whole frame.
Enough subject and scene continuity survives across the break for the failed flow to remain perceptible.
The result is not carried by generic RGB separation, random static, scanlines, VHS texture, or unrelated effect stacking alone.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can infer the selected source-medium failure mechanism from the same fingerprint repeated at three or more separated image locations; merely noticing that the image looks broken fails.
Malformed anatomy, fused objects, broken text, muddy texture, or one isolated synthesis defect does not carry the intended medium-native glitch.

obligation.composition_instruction: Make the drink's stability physically readable: the near-upright cup has broad visible base contact and slight fabric compression on a fully covered upper-torso support surface, its center of mass stays inside that support, and both hands remain clearly separated.

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.
